Richard E. Grant on 'Traitors' Exit: Didn't Expect to Be Taken Seriously

Actor Richard E. Grant has stated that his early departure from the celebrity reality show 'Traitors' was because he did not anticipate his fellow contestants would take his actions seriously. Grant admitted he felt "institutionalised" during his time on the show and is not watching the series.
